target_customer: Operations teams and small businesses that want internal tools, client portals and apps on top of Airtable, Google Sheets or SQL data without engineers
problem: Teams keep operations data in spreadsheets and databases but cannot get custom internal tools or portals without developer time.
business_model: SaaS subscription tiers by users and apps (self serve pricing)

founders.name: Darragh Mc Kay
founders.role: CEO and Founder (CTO in earlier coverage)
founders.background_notes: Background in software engineering per Noloco blog author bio; HubSpot and Trinity per Silicon Republic and community post snippets seen in search results.

founders.name: Simon Curran
founders.background_notes: Product background. Named as co-founder by Silicon Republic; the YC page lists only Mc Kay. Roles differ across sources.

competitors.name: Airtable
competitors.what: Spreadsheet database with interface and app features, also Noloco's main data source
competitors.traction_then: Large installed base; Airtable was a major no-code platform by 2021

competitors.name: Softr
competitors.what: No-code portal and app builder on Airtable and Sheets

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating permissioned apps over many data sources with workflows needs solid engineering, but standard web techniques.

defensibility.rationale: Apps built on the platform create some lock in, but several similar builders existed and the data stays in Airtable or Sheets.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Airtable added Interfaces and AI builders appeared later; Noloco repositioned toward AI portals and kept growing.

market_need_then: Rapid growth of no-code tools and spreadsheet based operations in 2020 and 2021; the company later claims over 1,000 teams as customers.

identity.logo: New logo introduced in a refresh built on connection and simplicity
identity.mascot_or_character: Nola, the AI app builder name
identity.visual_style: Redesigned site, palette and typography after Noloco 2.0

branding.brand_signature: Noloco and Nola AI naming system
branding.community_and_virality: Has a community forum and Product Hunt launches for Noloco 2.0.

brand_strength.rationale: Visible in no-code circles and a design refresh, but no independent press about the brand itself.

pivots.to: AI portal builder for teams with complex operations
pivots.why: Current positioning on the site; date not stated

outcome_analysis: Noloco is active with about 15 staff, raised a 1.4 million dollar pre-seed in July 2022 and claims over 1,000 teams. It has stayed small and capital efficient in a crowded no-code market and has moved toward AI app building. Whether a later round happened is not verified.
notes: The round is stated by Noloco as pre-seed and by Silicon Republic and others as seed, 1.4 million dollars. Unverified: geo.sig.ai lists a 3.97 million Series A in August 2024 and CB Insights lists a round on 2024-08-01 with 1.9 million total; neither was confirmed by a primary source so not recorded as a round. Competitor source dates are not available: the comparison pages are undated vendor pages and the as_of is the batch period. Founder roles differ between sources. Founding year conflicts (2020 vs 2021).
